title: Lathe
description: A record-cutting lathe seen from above with a black lacquer blank on the platter. Hold to cut a real spiral groove whose wobble is your hand moving up and down, then drop the needle and hear it played back.
intent: One machine finished to the edge: your hand is the signal, the stylus engraves it as a groove you can see under the microscope, and the playback needle reads that same groove back as sound.
